1.text: Aya ni yo mazina y'abana ba Isirayeli bagiye muri Egiputa bajyanye na Yakobo, umuntu wese ajyana abo mu rugo rwe:

2.text: Rubeni na Simiyoni na Lewi na Yuda,

3.text: na Isakari na Zebuluni na Benyamini,

4.text: na Dani na Nafutali na Gadi na Asheri.

5.text: Abantu bose bakomotse mu rukiryi rwa Yakobo bari mirongo irindwi, Yosefu yari asanzwe ari muri Egiputa.

6.text: Yosefu apfana na bene se bose, n'ab'icyo gihe bose.

7.text: Abisirayeli barororoka, barabyara cyane baragwira, barakomera cyane, buzura icyo gihugu.

8.text: Muri Egiputa hima undi mwami utigeze kumenya Yosefu.

9.text: Abwira abantu be ati “Dore Abisirayeli bahindutse ubwoko buturuta ubwinshi, buturusha n'amaboko.

10.text: Nimuze tubashakire ubwenge be kugwira, bikazatuma bafatanya n'ababisha bacu, habaho intambara bakaturwanya, bakava mu gihugu cyacu.”

11.text: Ni cyo cyatumye babaha abo kubatwara ku buretwa, ngo babababarishe imirimo iruhije. Bubakira Farawo imidugudu yo guhunikamo, Pitomu na Rāmesesi.

12.text: Ariko uko barushagaho kubababaza, na bo ni ko barushagaho kugwira no gukwira. Abanyegiputa banga Abisirayeli urunuka.

14.text: bababarisha ubugingo bwabo uburetwa bw'agahato, uburetwa bw'urwondo n'amatafari n'ubundi bwose bwo mu gasozi, uburetwa bwose babahatishaga.

15.text: Hariho ababyaza b'Abaheburayokazi umwe yitwa Shifura, undi yitwa Puwa. Umwami wa Egiputa arababwira ati

16.text: “Nimubyaza Abaheburayokazi mukabona bicaye ku ntebe babyariraho, nihavuka umuhungu mujye mumuhotora, ariko naba umukobwa abeho.”

17.text: Maze abo babyaza bubaha Imana, ntibakora ibyo bategetswe n'umwami wa Egiputa, ahubwo bareka abahungu babaho.

18.text: Umwami wa Egiputa ahamagaza abo babyaza, arababaza ati “Ni iki cyatumye mukora mutyo, mukareka abahungu bakabaho?”

19.text: Ababyaza basubiza Farawo bati “Ni uko Abaheburayokazi batamera nk'Abanyegiputakazi, kuko ari abanyambaraga, bakabyara umubyaza atarabageraho.”

20.text: Imana igirira neza abo babyaza, ubwo bwoko buragwira, burakomera cyane.

21.text: Kandi kuko abo babyaza bubashye Imana, ibaha urubyaro, baba imiryango.

22.text: Farawo ategeka abantu be bose ati “Umuhungu uzajya avuka wese mujye mumujugunya mu ruzi, umukobwa uzavuka wese mujye mumureka abeho.”
